HexKagune 1.0.24 for Forge 1.20.1 (clients need PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon). Install on client and server (protocol 42). Testing build.

- **Kagune tails stay attached during body animations:** rinkaku tails and centipede legs now follow your torso through leans, lunges, crouches, flips, rolls and spins, instead of hanging where your hips would be if you stood still.
- **Ayato's wings follow the whole torso too,** not only the backflip.
